text:
jordan: FYI - scheduling a focused hardening drill for our on-prem/private stack tomorrow 09:00 PDT. Scope: validate network egress lockdown, KMS provider failover (cloud -> local Vault), RBAC rollback safety, and audit integrity across the pipeline. Need sec + ops.
michelle.sec: I'm in. Please ensure audit logs contain k8s namespace, service account, key_id, and result. Also capture syscall execs for the keystore helper.
ravi.ops: We'll apply a scoped RBAC change (test-namespace only) that removes `cluster-admin` from test-sa and assigns a `keystore:decrypt` role. We'll have an idempotent rollback script.
jordan: Network policy plan: default deny egress, then allow to vault namespace and SIEM collector. Use mTLS to Vault on 8200 and TLS to siem on 6514. Snippet below.
michelle.sec: Add auditd rule: `-a exit,always -F arch=b64 -S execve -F subj_type=keystore_t -k keystore-exec` so we track agent execs. And Fluent-bit must sign-forward with client certs.
ravi.ops: Netpol snippet:
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: egress-lockdown-vault-siem
  namespace: test-namespace
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          component: vault
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8200
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.200.0.0/24
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 6514
```
jordan: Runbook: 1) prep and snapshot configs, 2) switch keystore to `vault://local`, 3) rotate key and revoke leases, 4) apply RBAC change, 5) monitor canary decrypts + SIEM events for 10m, 6) rollback if >5% failures or missing audit events.
michelle.sec: Known vuln note: the onprem keystore helper has a pending fix for CVE-2026-0099. For the drill we'll use patched image, but include a simulated agent crash to exercise fallback. Also add an exploitability checklist to the runbook.
jordan: I'll ask opsbot to open the runbook ticket. @opsbot create runbook "onprem-harden-rbac-kms-1775550001" with assignees ravi.ops, michelle.sec.
opsbot: runbook created: onprem-harden-rbac-kms-1775550001 - assignees: ravi.ops, michelle.sec - link: https://internal/runbooks/onprem-harden-rbac-kms-1775550001
michelle.sec: For SIEM validation: send a synthetic decrypt event after rotation, assert it arrives with correct JSON fields within 60s. Also validate that audit events contain `actor` and `key_id`.
ravi.ops: I'll prepare the idempotent RBAC rollback and a canary script that attempts decrypt every 8s and posts status to #eng-security-tests. Abort criteria: continuous failures >6 in 1m or no SIEM event within 90s.
jordan: Timeline: 08:30 prep, 09:00 start, 09:20 rollback window, 09:40 cleanup. Keep chatter here and canary output to #eng-security-tests. If anything looks off, abort immediately and escalate. :white_check_mark:
